stem: Seven orders are €20, €25, €30, €35, €40, €50 and €80: a mean of €40 and a median of €35. An eighth order of €900 comes in. What happens to the two statistics?

options.text: The mean rises by more than €100; the median rises by less than €5
The median rises by more than €100; the mean rises by less than €5
Both rise by about the same amount, since one order was added
Neither moves much, since one order out of eight is a small share
